scope: The original Singapore Art Museum at 71 Bras Basah Road, the former St Joseph’s Institution, as seen in November 2013. The scope covers the historic main building, curving two-story forecourt wings, domed tower, portico, and connected classroom and chapel masses.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum identifies the former school, central building, chapel, glass hall, and Queen and Waterloo Street wings, and dates the closure to 2019.
The conservation authority confirms the main building, chapel, classrooms and 71 Bras Basah Road address.
